Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Isha - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Shalini - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ayaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Ayaan: "And then?"

[Ayaan nods.]

Shalini: "Ayaan, listen!"

[Ayaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Ayaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Shalini (happily): "And then?"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Ayaan stands in the kitchen. Shalini and Isha stand near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ayaan makes tea for everyone.]

Ayaan: "I knew it!"

[Ayaan chops onions for the curry.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The park - Day

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan does push-ups.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan does yoga on a mat.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Isha skips rope.]

Isha: "That was such a fun day!"
